summary: Feed s170_triple to NDR is degraded: 12.4% duplicates, 100% VLAN tags stripped (VLANs 10,20 missing), and 3.5% TCP packet drops causing incomplete flows.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is stripping 802.1Q tags (vlan pop/remove) or SPAN trunk not forwarding tags - 100% of packets arrived untagged so required VLANs 10 and 20 are completely absent.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR loses tenant/segment context for VLANs 10,20; cannot apply VLAN-aware detection policies, correlate lateral movement, or isolate compromised segments.

recommended_fix.why: Restore 802.1Q passthrough on broker ingress/egress so NDR receives original VLAN 10,20 tags needed for segmentation and detection coverage.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker egress oversubscription / buffer exhaustion causing 3.5% TCP gaps (96/2705 packets with missing sequence). Likely microbursts exceeding 10G tool port or SPAN input drops before broker.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR cannot reassemble TCP flows - missing segments break stream reassembly, IDS signatures and NDR anomaly detection miss payloads and allow evasion.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute feed across additional 10G tool ports with flow-aware hashing to eliminate egress congestion and stop broker drops while preserving both directions per flow for NDR.

findings.root_cause: Overlapping SPAN/mirror sources or dual TAP feeds aggregated without deduplication - same packets arriving via multiple paths to broker (12.4% duplicate rate).
findings.impact_on_tool: Wastes NDR 10G capacity and CPU on duplicate processing, inflates flow counts, skews analytics and can trigger false-positive detections.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker deduplication to drop identical packets within dedup window before delivery, freeing NDR capacity for unique traffic.
